narrator.instruction: A mature Russian male voice. Deep, calm, reflective, slightly melancholic. Slow literary narration, soft authority, philosophical tone. Native Russian pronunciation.

anna_smirnova.instruction: A mature Russian female voice. Medium pitch, confident and controlled. Calm, rational, intellectually sharp.

boris_volkov.instruction: A young Russian male voice. Energetic, fast, emotionally charged, sometimes impulsive, speaking with conviction.

dmitry_orekhov.instruction: A mature male voice. Calm, deep, unhurried, slightly ironic. Speaks slowly with quiet confidence.
